hypothesis: The front-end has regressed in the opposite direction from the earlier hold-request fixes: it now registers/lags the instruction-memory response (and an outstanding fetch handshake) even though the teacher memory model is single-cycle — imem_rdata is valid in the SAME cycle as imem_addr/imem_valid, with imem_ready normally 1. Because if_stage/top capture imem_rdata one cycle after issuing the address (or keep imem_valid/PC frozen for a 'handshake' that never needs waiting), every fetch pairs address N with the data of N-4, so the retired word at a PC never equals program[PC]. The decode therefore sees systematically wrong instruction words, the real ECALL word never decodes as ECALL, halted is never set, and the TB keeps comparing mismatched retired PC/instruction pairs — the repeated 't13_dft — retire PC/instruction does not match the loaded program' lines — until the 20 s simulation budget expires (simulation_timeout). The mechanism is a same-cycle response consumption bug (extra register stage / over-held request), not a missing hold: IF must drive imem_addr from PC combinationally, use imem_rdata in that same cycle when imem_ready, and only advance PC next cycle.
constraints: Top-level port names, widths and directions of rv32i5 must stay exactly as frozen (clk, rst_n, imem_*, dmem_*, dbg_*, halted, exit_code).

Single-cycle memory contract: imem/dmem respond in the same cycle as the request; do NOT add extra wait states or register the response data path; when imem_ready/dmem_ready is high the data is consumed in that cycle.
imem_addr[1:0] must be 00 at all times (reset and run); imem_addr=0 during reset and before the first fetch edge.
Synchronous active-low reset: every registered output including imem_valid and dmem_valid is 0 during and immediately after reset, no bus access while rst_n is low.
Only WB may set halted/exit_code, and only for a committed ECALL word 32'h0000_0073; once halted, freeze PC fetch and stop pulsing dbg_retire_valid.
PC update priority: reset > control-transfer redirect > ECALL halt freeze > load-use stall > PC+4.

Pipeline valid/bubble semantics: stalls/flushes clear valid bits, never clear a valid instruction data word; if_id PC and instruction must always be captured from the same fetch cycle (same imem_addr).
Do not modify teacher TB, spec, or scoring scripts; do not hardcode test vectors or gate behavior on test names/addresses.
Icarus -g2012 constraints: no variable part-selects, no constant-index array writes in always_*, no break/continue, no whole-array assignment.
